environment: Windows / Node24.19.0 / owned byte-equivalent isolated clone / Vitest V8 and local MSW

findings.rootCause: App/global/lazy error reporters log original errors; render and route fallbacks expose original exception messages or response status text outside development.
findings.behavior: Keep sanitized telemetry delivery; allow application-owned raw diagnostics only in development and render generic release errors.

findings.rootCause: Functional storage updates read a render closure; cross-tab deletion/clear events and storage-area identity are ignored. Tabs change selection without focus. Custom picker does not activate from the keyboard.
findings.behavior: Maintain latest value synchronously, handle deletion/clear and ignore foreign storage, move focus with selection, and support Enter/Space without reacting to nested inputs.

findings.rootCause: Form contexts use truthy empty objects, making composition checks ineffective and yielding undefined control IDs; the error Home button resets the same failing render.
findings.behavior: Fail clearly for missing form/field/item owners; provide a real root recovery link outside the failing React subtree.

diagnostics: The first Storage area fixture was incompatible with the shared plain-object Storage mock; its harness TypeError is excluded, corrected4 failures counted.

Prettier produced an unexpected-multiline ESLint error for new tab focus syntax; used a named tab list, did not relax lint.
Expected React/jsdom diagnostics from deliberately failing render fixtures are retained; application-owned release logging is tested separately.
